intro_section.title: Private Transfer Between Liberia Airport and Tamarindo
paragraphs: Wild Papagayo arranges private transportation between Liberia Airport (LIR) and Tamarindo, in both directions. The vehicle and driver are for your group only — not a shared shuttle — and the drive takes approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes to central Tamarindo in normal conditions.

Liberia Airport is officially Daniel Oduber Quirós International Airport and is also known as Guanacaste Airport. Pricing for this route is by quote: send your dates, direction, group size and flight details on WhatsApp and we will reply with a quote.

Properties served on this route include Tamarindo Diria Beach Resort, Hotel Occidental Tamarindo, Wyndham Tamarindo, Cala Luna Boutique Hotel and other hotels in the Tamarindo and Playa Langosta area. JW Marriott Guanacaste Resort & Spa, located near Playa Conchal approximately 15 minutes north of central Tamarindo, is also served with a drive time of approximately 1 hour and 35 minutes from Liberia Airport. If your property is not listed, include its name when you request your quote.

how_it_works.title: How Your Transfer Works, Step by Step
steps: Send your request on WhatsApp: the direction (airport to Tamarindo, or back to the airport), your date, flight details, group size and your hotel name.
We check availability and reply with a quote.
If you go ahead, we confirm your booking in writing and arrange a private vehicle and driver for your group.
On arrival at LIR, your driver meets you in the arrivals area with a sign bearing your name. Exact meeting details are confirmed with your booking.
For the return trip, tell us your departure flight time and we plan your pickup for the drive back to Liberia Airport.

return_leg.title: Return Transportation From Tamarindo to Liberia Airport

The drive back takes approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes from central Tamarindo to Liberia Airport in normal conditions, so allow for it when choosing your departure flight.
